title: Only One Grows Old
logline: Two players trade compliments across a valley, then spend the whole match building towers. When they finally meet up high, the older one drops on the younger from above.

narration.speaker: taborgreat
narration.text: you look great from over here on that hill top
On the open plains, taborgreat calls to a neighbour across the valley.
WorkingStorage does not answer the threat. He gathers earth instead.

narration.speaker: taborgreat
narration.text: only one of us will grow old
Then, block by block, he climbs, high above the grass, where nothing can follow.
Sixty-one blocks of dirt. A nest in the sky.
Much later, taborgreat has learned the habit. He builds his own perch, right beside the old nest.
Zombies and spiders have chewed at him all evening. Now the two meet at last.
